events.note: The human's declared risk (high) stands; the scorer is advisory and file-count driven only. It saw 9 files and no sensitive path, but it cannot see the hazard class: this task closes SQLite connections shared across threads while reads may still be in flight, and the plan rates 'releasing the old epoch's files before in-flight reads finish' as 'muy alto: corrupción de datos y caídas intermitentes difíciles de reproducir'. A wrong rest predicate leaks every file descriptor while reporting success.

MEASURED 2026-08-30 with SQLite 3.53.4: a read-only WAL connection creates <db>-shm (32768 bytes) and a zero-byte <db>-wal, and both SURVIVE its close because a read-only connection may not delete them; a later read-write open plus close does remove them. Every PoolDeConocimiento connection is read-only by construction (FR-05, adr-0003), so under the strict reading of AC-3/AC-4 every real production drain ends in CompanieroDeEpocaSobreviviente. The contract implements the strict reading and carries the observed -wal byte size on the error; the human must rule between keeping it strict or tolerating a zero-byte -wal as data-free residue.
